page_title: WOL 2-4 BOU | Wolves v Bournemouth 30/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Peter Bankes is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Peter Bankes had an easy-decision to make.
90+2' Bournemouth enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
89' Peter Bankes blows his whistle. Nelson Semedo (Wolves) commits a foul after dangerous play.
88' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
85' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Wolves.
82' Here is a change. Andre is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) replaces Marcos Senesi.
77' Substitution. Justin Kluivert makes way for Philip Billing (Bournemouth).
77' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Enes Unal (Bournemouth) replacing Evanilson.
76' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Mario Lemina (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
74' 2 - 4 Goal! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jose Sa to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
74' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
73' Jose Sa (Wolves) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
71' Jose Sa (Wolves) trips an opposition player and Peter Bankes signals a foul. Bournemouth are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
69' 2 - 3 Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) latches on to a pass and finds himself in a great position inside the box before unleashing a stunning effort into the top of the net.
67' Great teamplay by Wolves as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carlos Forbs (Wolves) comes onto the pitch so that Jean-Ricner Bellegarde can be given a rest.
64' That's the end of the game for Toti, who is replaced by Goncalo Guedes (Wolves).
64' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. David Brooks will be replaced by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
63' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
61' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
60' A cross into the box from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolves.
59' A fine solo run by Toti (Wolves) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the right post.
58' Bournemouth enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
56' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
55' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Jose Sa easily deals with the threat.
53' It's like he was asking for a caution. Craig Dawson (Wolves) receives a yellow card.
52' Wonderful movement by Wolves. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
50' Peter Bankes blows his whistle and it's Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
48' Wolves are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Gary O'Neil gives a chance to Craig Dawson (Wolves) and Rodrigo Gomes is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+9' Peter Bankes has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+7' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
45+5' Wolves showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
45+1' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) was quite harsh and Peter Bankes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
41' Neat passing move from Bournemouth in order to create new attacking opportunities.
39' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

38' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
38' David Brooks (Bournemouth) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
36' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
35' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
32' Wolves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
31' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
28' The game is interrupted now, Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' The resulting corner from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is cleared by the defence.
27' Wolves are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.
24' Wolves keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
20' Wolves control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
18' 1 - 3 Goal! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Jose Sa.
17' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
16' The Bournemouth players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
16' Referee Peter Bankes makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Bournemouth. Let’s see what happens!
15' One of the Bournemouth players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
12' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

11' Evanilson (Bournemouth) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

11' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Jose Sa thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
8' 1 - 2 Goal! Marcus Tavernier plays a simple square pass into the feet of Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the top left corner. 1:2.
7' The Wolves players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' 1 - 1 Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) scores from a quite difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the left post. Excellent finish.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bournemouth.
3' 0 - 1 GOAL! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) strikes the penalty low down the middle and scores after the ball glances off the leg of Jose Sa.
3' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is going to take the penalty!
2' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is punished with the yellow card.
2' One of the Wolves players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. Bournemouth are awarded a penalty kick!
1' The first half has started.
Wolves will kick-off.
Peter Bankes will supervise the game today.
